items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: this Jones fellow that was the announcer and master ceremony of Lincoln Garden he talked me in to coming into Lincoln Garden on this job

ctx.x: And so at that time I'm on drums and I had a woman playing piano with me that her fingers were so extra long they were just about half again as long as mine. And she was one of Clarence Jones the scholars and she was a genius at the piano. And she could cover tense with just laying her hands on the piano with full harmony. I brought her from the west side over here to the south side and I organized this little band and the reason I mentioned her about her being a genius in which nobody on the south side knows she…
Oh yes. I met him years ago.
